authority_contribution: Query results contribute typed, provenance-bearing evidence to XAIML validation and XCFE admission: source scope, key resolution, pattern matches, wildcard bindings, field/graph records, and response-template bindings.
description: Broader XPath 3.1 expression grammar for the existing XAIML read, match, retrieve, rank, and response-template flow. It describes current source surfaces with richer standard syntax; it does not introduce a new authority model or install handlers.

authorities.syntax_reference: XPath 3.1 grammar and Functions and Operators specifications
authorities.phase_lifecycle: Pop -> Wo -> Yax -> Sek -> Ch'en -> Xul

surface.grammar_profile: XPath 3.1 EBNF; individual runtime functions and productions retain explicit implementation status

operator_mapping.MAP: registered pure item transform or semantic key lookup
operator_mapping.FILTER: registered pure predicate over a typed sequence
operator_mapping.FOLD: ordered accumulation with explicit direction and initial value
operator_mapping.REDUCE: typed aggregation or deterministic ordering over a collection
operator_mapping.context_read: reads a value bound in the evaluation context; not an operator lane

query_sources.source_scope: A query may read only sources declared by the XAIML pattern's static sync bindings and admitted lane set.

source_kinds.access: declared graph reference and bounded traversal
declared field key or field reference
registered AIML bank and its pattern matcher

query_sources.wildcards: A wildcard binds only captures produced by the matched XAIML/AIML pattern; every capture keeps its index, type, and source reference.
query_sources.template_expansion: AIML templates render matched, provenance-bearing records and captures; the template does not gain ambient file, network, or execution access.
query_sources.query_language_boundary: XPath 3.1 supplies the expression syntax (including paths, predicates, function calls, sequences, maps, arrays, and FLWOR forms). XAIML resolves those expressions against its existing declared GML/field/key/AIML sources and typed function registry; the grammar does not grant ambient file/network access or bypass existing XAIML/XCFE validation.

source_adapters.result: graph records with relation and source identity
registered key records and their grammar evidence

source_adapters.status: existing declaration; host handler still required
source_adapters.result: matched pattern reference and indexed wildcard captures

source_adapters.status: existing declaration; host handler still required

retrieval_pipeline.operation: normalize query and bind input provenance; derive candidate semantic keys and declared wildcard captures
bind only pattern-declared source references, lane modes, key scopes, and output template
read matching GML nodes/edges, field records, key rows, and AIML pattern candidates within the declared scope
apply typed predicates, deduplicate by declared identity policy, order deterministically, and enforce result limit
validate item types, capture bindings, source provenance, and response-template bindings; preserve misses and conflicts
emit the read-only response-feed candidate; persistence or external execution requires separate authorization

response_feed.ordering: deterministic relevance/order policy with stable source-order tie-break
response_feed.limit: bounded by the XAIML query budget
response_feed.missing_source_policy: emit a typed miss or partial-feed status; never fabricate a source item
response_feed.rendering: A registered AIML template may render feed items into a user response while preserving item source references.

provenance_and_scope.graph_traversal_requires: declared start key + allowed relation set + depth/limit bounds
provenance_and_scope.field_read_requires: declared field reference and permitted lane mode
provenance_and_scope.pattern_match_requires: registered pattern bank; matched template is data until validated and expanded
provenance_and_scope.query_does_not_grant: filesystem access, network access, execution, fact verification, or persistent write

functions.name: fn:fold-left
functions.order: left-to-right; do not rewrite as right fold

functions.name: fn:fold-right
functions.order: right-to-left; do not rewrite as left fold

functions.name: fn:distinct-values
functions.equality: typed equality and collation must be declared; preserve first occurrence

functions.name: fn:sum
functions.ordering: accumulation order is explicit for non-associative numeric carriers

functions.name: fn:deep-equal
functions.equality: typed structural comparison; not string serialization comparison

functions.name: map:get
functions.immutability: returns values; source map is unchanged

functions.name: map:keys
functions.ordering: map key enumeration order must be explicit

functions.name: array:flatten
functions.type_law: Array and Sequence are distinct carriers; flatten is explicit

functions.name: fn:current-dateTime
functions.determinism: clock value is captured once at ingress and reused during replay

function_items.inline_function_expressions: represented by the XPath 3.1 grammar; execution requires static typing, effect checks, and an admitted implementation
function_items.dynamic_calls: resolved only through registered function keys; unresolved targets fail XAIML validation
function_items.implementation_binding: host registry maps a declared key to a native handler; grammar acceptance or a KGF edge alone does not register code

authority_boundary.verdict_owner: XAIML validation plus XCFE admission contract

semantic_invariants: Sequence<T> and Array<T> are separate types.
fold-left and fold-right preserve their different traversal directions.
distinct-values and deep-equal require an explicit typed equality/collation policy.
map:get and related map functions return values and do not mutate or persist the source map.
sort must declare deterministic ordering rules.
current-dateTime reads a clock value bound once to the evaluation context.
DECLARED does not mean IMPLEMENTED; handlers require trusted host registration.
function execution remains subject to XCFE admission and host authorization.
